title: google.longrunning Operations and Operation primary protocol definition
section: DeleteOperation lines 77–86; CancelOperation lines 88–105; WaitOperation lines 107–116; Operation.done/result lines 133–155
read_status: Complete original UTF-8 file obtained through GitHub connector; relevant sections read; reached through AIP-151 reference link.
observed_facts: CancelOperation starts asynchronous cancellation and is best effort; clients check whether cancellation succeeded or the operation completed despite cancellation.
Successful cancellation is represented by an existing Operation with error code CANCELLED; it is not deletion of the operation.
DeleteOperation means the client is no longer interested in the operation result and does not cancel the operation.
done=false means in progress; done=true accompanies an error or response, so completion and success are separate distinctions.
limits: Cancelling a long-running rescheduling operation is not specified to cancel the underlying booking or reverse prior effects.
The method can be unsupported; unsupported cancellation must not be shown as available.
This source supplies protocol semantics, not empirical evidence that proposed Japanese labels work for users.
